_comment: Poland. Only exemptions (docs/qa/east-europe.md); everything else from _default.

exemptions.reason: Freight bypasses (name: 'Towarowa Obwodnica' = freight bypass) typed Intercity from usage=main alone; no passenger route runs on them.

Magistrala Weglowa (lines 131 and 201) and the Magistrala Podsudecka (line 137) are freight trunk lines; only the sections that have no passenger route relation are changed, the sections with passenger service keep the route type.
